name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: a Plex friend's declined-to-share library could still get synced. Unlike a Jellyfin friend (whose own server enforces sharing remotely - a library they don't share is invisible to every check we make), a Plex access token has no per-library scope at all, so nothing on this side ever recorded or enforced which of a friend's Plex libraries were actually OK to sync - GetRemoteLibraries also silently failed to connect for any Plex server at all, so the picker never even worked for one. Added RemoteServer.AllowedExternalLibraryIds, a per-server allow-list enforced directly in PlexCatalogProvider (both the library picker and the actual sync refuse anything not on it), a Servers/{id}/AllowedLibraries endpoint to set it, and fixed the picker to actually list a Plex server's libraries. Null (no allow-list on record) still means unrestricted, so no existing setup silently loses access. 280 tests, all green.
